title: Rigidity of Koebe Polyhedra and Inversive Distance Circle Packings
summary: Hyperbolic inversive distance circle packings on the $2$-sphere correspond to Koebe polyhedra in the Beltrami-Klein model $\mathbb{B}^{3}$ of hyperbolic $3$-space. Koebe polyhedra are triangulated convex hyperbolic polyhedra with hyperideal vertices whose faces meet $\mathbb{B}^{3}$. We prove the global rigidity of these circle packings or, equivalently, of these Koebe polyhedra under mild assumptions on the links of their vertices.
